svg.title: Physical KV pools behind the layer router
svg.desc: A router sends each layer to one of three physical pools: the full KV pool of N tokens for full attention layers, the SWA KV pool of 0.8 N tokens for sliding window layers, and the Mamba pool with one state slot per request. req_to_token holds full-pool slots only, and SWA layers map a full slot to an SWA slot through full_to_swa_index_mapping.
svg.text: Physical pools behind a layer_id -> pool router
SWA layers read full_to_swa_index_mapping[slot] -> SWA slot
